prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: flat 2D overhead wizard sprite concept.
Primary request: A wizard represented ONLY by a magic hat and a wand, for a strictly 2D HTML Canvas game viewed from exactly 90 degrees overhead. Show one large clean simple sprite centered on plain warm parchment background. NOT a standing wizard illustration.
Geometry: the hat is seen exactly from directly ABOVE. Its brim is a perfectly circular flat disk, muted terracotta coral #EF795E with a dark pine #182C28 thin outline. Inside that disk, a smaller concentric flat circle in slightly darker terracotta represents the pointed hat crown seen from ABOVE; its tiny tip is a small dot close to the center. A small simple flat golden band detail may be a concentric ring. Because the camera looks straight down the vertical hat axis, there is NO tall triangular hat silhouette. A short straight wand, simple dark brown narrow rectangle ending in a small brass #C58A45 circle, lies in the same 2D plane just outside the hat on the upper-right diagonal. The wand is the only other object.
Style: extremely simple flat solid-color vector-like game sprite, 2-4 colors, clean slightly friendly contour, calm warm storybook color feeling using shape only. Strong compact silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Entire object orthographic plan view. No text.
Strict prohibitions: NO face, NO eyes, NO face hole, NO visible head, NO body, NO cloak, NO hands, NO feet, NO underside of brim, NO visible side surface, NO perspective, NO ellipse for brim, NO 3D, NO 2.5D, NO isometric, NO front-facing triangular hat, NO cast shadow, NO shading, NO gradients, NO texture, NO ground props, NO sparkles, NO glowing effects. It should look like circles and one rectangle drawn with HTML Canvas, never a render.
